note: Does the winning recipe HOLD with more tokens, or is it another short-horizon artifact? The full recipe delta (LR 3e-4 + warmup 10% + gated attention + untied embeddings) was -0.366 at 35M, measured e06 6.4280 -> e20 6.0619. This runs the same stack at 48M so it can be compared against e10, the old-recipe baseline at 48M (6.0409). If the delta is still ~-0.366 the recipe is scale-robust; if it shrinks, the gains are horizon-dependent and the production recommendation needs hedging. After arms 22-23 this guard is not optional.
